body.message:
I checked the Google reviews for the building and saw that some people complained about issues like water leakage, damp walls, old apartments, and kitchen appliances not working properly.

Since I haven’t seen the apartment in person yet, I just want to make sure my apartment has no such issues and everything is in good condition.

If I move in and face any serious problems like these, or not clean or bad smell or dirty bed or soda , I expect that you will arrange another apartment for me
